# cloudminator_images (Data Source)

OS images available for `cloudminator_vm.image`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudminator_images" "eu" {
  region = "eu-central-1"
}

output "image_ids" {
  value = data.cloudminator_images.eu.images[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `region` (String) Only images bootable in this region.

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))
- `simulated` (Boolean) No real hypervisor behind the list.

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Image id, e.g. `debian-13`.
- `label` (String) Display label.
